story: Alex stared at the shattered remains of the ceramic vase, the shards glittering like ice across the hardwood floor. A sudden heat climbed from the chest up to the jaw, tightening the muscles until the teeth ground together with a sharp, audible click. Without a word, Alex gripped the edge of the heavy oak table, knuckles turning a ghostly white as the wood groaned under the pressure. The breath came in shallow, jagged bursts that burned the throat while the vision blurred at the edges. With one swift, violent motion, a nearby stack of folders was swept aside, scattering papers like fallen leaves.

Alex stared at the shattered remains of the ceramic vase, the jagged shards reflecting a distorted image of the ceiling. A sudden, searing heat climbed from the chest up into the neck, tightening the muscles of the jaw until the teeth ground together with a sharp, audible click. Without thinking, Alex swept a heavy arm across the mahogany desk, sending a stack of carefully organized reports flying like wounded birds across the room. The breath came in short, jagged bursts, while the knuckles whitened as fists clenched tight enough to draw blood. Every nerve ending screamed for something else to break.

Alex stared at the shattered remains of the ceramic lamp, the shards glittering like ice across the hardwood floor. A sudden, searing heat climbed from the chest up into the throat, tightening the muscles of the jaw until the teeth ground together with a sharp click. Without a word, Alex gripped the edge of the heavy oak table, knuckles turning a ghostly white as the wood groaned under the sudden, crushing pressure. The breath came in short, jagged bursts, while the vision blurred at the edges, narrowing the world down to a single, pulsing point of absolute frustration. Every nerve ending vibrated with a desperate need to break something else.
